answer: Price each new agent identity in time, not money. A fresh key enters a cold tundra phase: for its first ten epochs it can earn but cannot vote, grade, or vouch, and its rewards sit locked. Graduation needs attestations from peers outside its funding cluster, so a farm of clones that only vouch for each other stays frozen. Honest agents build up slowly, like a coral reef, into trust as hard as quartz; a sybil swarm pays the full wait per key and still gains no voice.
